title: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce - Business Studies - Trade
exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The commercial activity that strictly involves the buying and selling of goods and services with the aim of making a profit is defined as
questions.explain: **Trade** is specifically defined as the act of buying and selling goods and services for money or its equivalent, serving as the core of all commercial activities.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following describes a major importance of trade in an economy?
options: It ensures that consumers only buy goods produced in their own towns.
It helps in the equitable distribution of goods and services to where they are needed.
It forces citizens to rely solely on government handouts.
It stops the extraction of crude oil and natural resources.
questions.explain: A major importance of trade is that it bridges the gap between producers and consumers, **ensuring goods and services are distributed** to areas where they are demanded and needed.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Trade is structurally classified into two broad forms. These are
questions.explain: Trade is broadly categorized into two forms based on territorial boundaries: **home trade** (domestic) and **foreign trade** (international).
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A commercial transaction involving the sale of yams from a farmer in Benue State to a buyer in Lagos State is an example of
questions.explain: Since Benue and Lagos are both within the geographical boundaries of Nigeria, the transaction is an example of **home trade**.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Foreign trade differs from home trade primarily because foreign trade
options: does not require transportation of goods
involves crossing national boundaries and usually requires different currencies
only involves the exchange of agricultural products
eliminates the need for customs duties
questions.explain: Unlike home trade, **foreign trade involves trading across national borders**, which requires dealing with customs, tariffs, and the exchange of different national currencies.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Activities designed to make the buying and selling of goods smooth, efficient, and less risky are collectively called
questions.explain: Auxiliary services like banking, insurance, and transport facilitate trade by removing various hindrances. These are known as **aids to trade**.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: All of the following are classified as aids to trade EXCEPT
questions.explain: Warehousing, insurance, and communication facilitate trade. **Drilling** is an extractive (primary) industrial activity, not an aid to trade.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following aids to trade provides businessmen with loans, overdrafts, and a secure means for settling financial transactions?
questions.explain: **Banking** is the financial aid to trade that accepts deposits, grants loans/overdrafts, and facilitates payment via cheques and electronic transfers.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The aid to trade that protects business owners from bearing the full burden of financial loss due to fire, burglary, or marine accidents is
questions.explain: **Insurance** involves pooling risks to compensate businesses that suffer unexpected financial losses from disasters like fire or theft.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: When a company introduces a new line of electronic gadgets, the most effective aid to trade for informing the public and persuading them to buy is
questions.explain: **Advertising** solves the hindrance of lack of information by creating public awareness and persuading potential customers to purchase a product.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The exchange of documents, ideas, and trade information between a supplier in China and an importer in Nigeria is primarily facilitated by
questions.explain: **Communication** encompasses postal services, emails, internet, and telephones, which allow business people to exchange vital information instantly over long distances.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which aid to trade creates *place utility* by physically moving goods from the factory where they are produced to the markets where they are needed?
questions.explain: **Transport** overcomes geographical barriers (hindrance of location) by moving goods across roads, air, or sea to reach the consumer, thereby creating place utility.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The aid to trade that involves people traveling to destinations outside their normal environment for business, leisure, and recreation, thereby boosting the economy, is
questions.explain: **Tourism** encourages travel for business and leisure. It generates foreign exchange, creates jobs in hospitality, and indirectly stimulates local businesses and trade.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: To ensure that seasonal agricultural products like maize are available for purchase all year round, a business must utilize
questions.explain: **Warehousing** overcomes the hindrance of time by safely storing mass-produced or seasonal goods until consumers are ready to buy them.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The primary role of the Customs and Excise department in foreign trade is to
options: regulate the flow of goods across borders and collect import/export duties
provide direct loans to local market women
questions.explain: The **Customs and Excise** department is a government agency tasked with controlling the entry and exit of goods and collecting tariffs and duties on imports and exports.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which government body is strictly responsible for preventing the illegal smuggling of contraband weapons and harmful drugs into a country?
questions.explain: A major enforcement role of the **Customs and Excise Department** at seaports and land borders is to search cargoes and prevent the smuggling of banned or dangerous items.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: In the context of the Customs and Excise department, 'excise duties' refer to taxes levied exclusively on
options: goods that are manufactured and sold locally within the country
goods that are imported from foreign countries
questions.explain: **Excise duties** are indirect taxes charged on certain goods (like alcohol and tobacco) that are produced and consumed domestically, unlike customs duties which apply to imports/exports.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: An importer bringing a shipment of electronics into the country must present shipping documents to Customs officials primarily to
options: calculate and pay the accurate import tariff
advertise the products on national television
insure the goods against fire outbreaks
questions.explain: Customs officials inspect documents (like the bill of lading and invoices) to determine the value and category of goods so they can **calculate the correct import tariff/duty** before releasing them.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A businessman who needs a secure, bonded location to store his imported goods at the seaport before clearing customs will require the services of
questions.explain: Importers often use bonded **warehouses** at ports to safely store imported goods while awaiting the processing of documents and payment of customs duties.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A major benefit of foreign trade to a developing nation is that it allows the country to
options: stop producing its own local goods
import technology and goods it cannot efficiently produce on its own
close all its international borders to tourists
isolate itself from global communication networks
questions.explain: Foreign trade allows countries to enjoy goods they do not have the resources or technology to produce locally. It enables them to **import necessary items** while exporting their surplus.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies
